description.value: Coastal Cookery is a West Coast restaurant and bar on Marine Avenue in Powell River, open since 2014 and part of the Point Group Hospitality group. The interior features a Redwood Cedar bar, Alder and Fir finishing, and views of the Strait of Malaspina. The kitchen focuses on locally sourced ingredients presented with globally inspired flavours.
